description: Source code for the Cart API controller in the OpenCart e-commerce platform, handling operations such as viewing cart contents, adding, editing, and removing products, including support for subscriptions and options.

classes.name: Cart
classes.description: Controller class managing shopping cart operations such as viewing, adding, editing, and removing items, with support for product options and subscriptions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles fetching and returning the current cart contents, totals, taxes, and shipping requirements as a JSON API response.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Handles adding a product to the cart, with validation for options, subscriptions, and product existence.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Updates the quantity of a cart item based on provided key and quantity.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cart item based on provided key.
